newsitem.title: PERU: Lima share prices end mixed, seen rising Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Lima share prices end mixed, seen rising Tuesday.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed mixed Monday as benchmark Telefonica del Peru saw a technical correction that dragged down leading companies' prices while investors bought second tier stocks, brokers said.

They added the market would likely see solid gains Tuesday based on optimism that January's year-on-year gross domestic product (GDP) figure -- to be announced during the session -- would be healthy, they added.
Monday, the General Index .IGRA rose 0.34 percent to 1,546.1 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL slipped 0.04 percent to 2,218.2 points.
In a total of 1,213 trades, 36 stocks rose, 28 remained unchanged and 14 fell. Volume was 22.8 million soles ($8.6 million).

"Selling of the telecoms was balanced out by the fact that players continued to buy second tier companies, which have been lagging behind the market's recent general upswing," Arnoldo Fiorani of local brokerage Interfip said.
Telefonica fell 0.35 percent, closing at 5.71 soles with 25.9 percent of the day's total trade.
Miner Buenaventura -- until January a bluechip stock -- was the second most heavily traded stock and rose 2.65 percent to 18.60 soles with 15.8 percent of the session's volume.
